items.headline: Staff Backend Engineer, distributed systems
items.summary: Fourteen years designing the systems that cannot go down: hospital networks, public health platforms, retail ERPs. Java and Spring Boot, event-driven architecture, concurrent socket integrations and the observability to prove they hold. Master's in artificial intelligence; ships models as services when the problem asks for it.

achievements: Designed an event-driven auditing architecture on Spring Boot and RabbitMQ that lifted cross-cutting concerns out of the services that used to carry them.
Turned operational data into real-time analytics the organization uses to monitor and decide.
Built simulation-friendly interfaces and test harnesses so operational scenarios could be validated before they happened.
Led two junior developers and coordinated delivery with QA, backend and design.
Core member of the nationwide system team recognized by WHO/PAHO in 2023 for digital health innovation.
Designed HL7 interoperability over TCP/IP (MLLP) with concurrent socket communication between hospitals and the central platform.
Built the centralized identity service with Spring Security and JWT for a microservices architecture.
Introduced CI/CD pipelines and automated testing across the platform.
Built ERP-integrated workflows for inventory, billing, sales and purchasing.
Created a national incident-monitoring platform that reduced fraud and tightened operational control.
Designed the data-integrity mechanisms for enterprise processing across distributed transactions.

items.headline: Senior Full-stack Engineer, .NET and React
items.summary: Eleven years building and running web, mobile and API products end to end, most recently white-label fintech platforms for a US client. .NET across every generation from WebForms to .NET Core, Clean Architecture, React on the front, Azure underneath. Comfortable owning requirements, delivery and the troubleshooting in between.

achievements: Developed and optimized full-stack solutions for white-label fintech products on ASP.NET (WebForms, MVC, .NET Core), Clean Architecture, React and SQL Server with Dapper, improving scalability and performance.
Implemented secure third-party integrations and authentication with JWT and webhooks.
Delivered mobile and web applications on Flutter, Angular, .NET, React and Node.js with seamless API integrations.
Led requirement analysis, troubleshooting and iterative releases, leaving products more stable and easier to extend.

items.headline: Senior Android Engineer, Kotlin and Flutter
items.summary: Nine years on Android, from utility billing apps used in the field to published consumer products on Google Play. Kotlin with modern Jetpack (Compose, Hilt, Flow), MVVM and Clean Architecture, plus Flutter when one codebase has to serve both stores. Builds from zero and maintains legacy with the same care.

achievements: Built a Flutter application on MVVM with REST consumption, Provider state, local persistence and background services.
Developed and maintains the Kotlin Android application: MVVM, Flow, UI states, Jetpack Compose and dependency injection with Hilt.
Extended a Java Android application with new features while migrating its code to current Android SDK versions.
Built an Android app that measures and records shots at firearm practice ranges.
Created a health app that gives nutritional recommendations based on pharmaceutical studies.
Developed the apps candidates use to prepare for Spanish public service examinations.
Built billing and collection apps used by power utilities in El Salvador and Guatemala.
Created a Flutter customer-service app with invoice history and FAQ.

items.headline: Senior Mobile Engineer, Flutter, iOS and React Native
items.summary: Six years shipping mobile apps that carry real traffic, in Flutter first, SwiftUI and React Native when the platform asks for it. Has led a Flutter team, owns the backend side in Node.js, NestJS or .NET, and knows the e-commerce plumbing (VTEX, Shopify) that mobile checkouts depend on. Diagnoses incidents end to end: mobile, backend and store.

achievements: Developed and maintained high-traffic Flutter applications in production, with backend support in Node.js.
Integrated catalog, cart and order flows with the VTEX platform and resolved incidents end to end across mobile, backend and e-commerce.
Optimized app performance and API consumption.
Built Flutter apps with REST, Firebase and analytics, and SwiftUI views following Apple's Human Interface Guidelines.
Took part in architecture decisions; set up CI/CD with Codemagic and store releases.
Optimized performance and wrote unit and widget tests.
Integrated real-time communication with Agora and app protection with RASP.
Built in-app support features and geospatial map features such as route polylines.
Profiled and optimized with Dart DevTools.
Led the Flutter team on decisions and practices; delivered mobile and Flutter Web solutions deployed on GCP with Docker.
Contributed key flows to VTEX and Shopify e-commerce projects; earlier built .NET Core REST services on MySQL.
Built web applications on ASP.NET Web Forms and MVC with SQL Server reporting; refactored legacy apps for performance.

items.headline: Senior Backend and DevOps Engineer, Node.js and event-driven systems
items.summary: Backend engineer who also runs the infrastructure his systems live on. TypeScript and Node.js with Kafka and RabbitMQ at the core, from a production-scheduling engine with an event backbone to messaging platforms that carry traffic for telecoms. On the other side of the deploy: Linux, GCP, AWS, Docker and the CI/CD to get there.

achievements: Designed a microservices architecture on Express and Next.js joined by a Kafka event backbone, keeping orders, inventory and notifications consistent while decoupled.
Built the scheduling engine: a Tetris-style optimizer that loads machines, inserts critical orders and shifts existing production.
Modeled concurrent production between areas with WIP buffers and micro-batches, and real-time traceability that reschedules on reported deviations.
Automated deployment with Docker.
Runs Linux servers, MySQL and PostgreSQL (hosted and containerized) with migrations and backups, and access and firewall policy.
Administers GCP (snapshots, load balancers, CDN, instances, IAM) and AWS services (SES, RDS, EC2) for production environments.

experience.industryDescriptor: digital agency serving telecoms and retail
achievements: Built a Twilio-style messaging platform on Node.js and Kafka, event-driven, integrating Gupshup, Amazon SES, Meta, Twilio and SparkPost for telecom and call-center clients.
Developed geolocation-based recommendation services (Turf.js, Google Maps, KMZ processing) for a telecom operator.
Delivered e-commerce backends on NestJS, Redis and RabbitMQ with React frontends for supermarket and coffee retail chains.

items.headline: Full-stack Engineer, React, .NET and cross-platform mobile
items.summary: Six years taking products from first architecture to the App Store, Google Play or production web. React and Next.js on the front, .NET and SQL Server behind, Flutter and React Native for mobile, with the release plumbing (Firebase, push, in-app purchases, store consoles) handled. Has worked under financial regulation and knows what a compliant component looks like.

achievements: Builds native-feeling iOS and Android interfaces in Flutter, integrating REST and GraphQL APIs with real-time sync and reliable local persistence.

experience.industryDescriptor: regional retail and consumer finance group
achievements: Developed WhatsApp-connected landing pages that render personalized product recommendations.
Built virtual assistants and interactive recruiting panels in React and Blazor.
Standardized frontend components across corporate repositories to meet financial regulation (SUGEF 10-07).
Cut memory use in infinite video feeds with a tuned FlatList in React Native.
Implemented session persistence and real-time transaction state with Redux and Zustand; designed the Firebase authentication flows.
Designed and built fast, SEO-optimized landing pages on React, Vite and Tailwind.
Built point-of-sale interfaces integrated with a .NET backend and SQL Server.

items.headline: Senior QA Automation Engineer, end-to-end and performance
items.summary: Eight years making releases boring. Builds the automation that lets a team ship daily: end-to-end suites in Playwright that stay green, contract tests between services, and load tests in k6 that find the ceiling before customers do. Treats flaky tests as bugs and test code as production code.

achievements: Replaced a two-day manual regression cycle with a Playwright suite that runs in under twenty minutes on every pull request.
Introduced consumer-driven contract tests between fourteen services, catching breaking API changes before integration.
Designed k6 load scenarios for open-enrollment peaks and turned their results into capacity targets the platform team builds against.
Built the Cypress automation for booking and payment flows across three brands and six currencies.
Set up test data management so suites run in parallel against isolated environments.
Wrote the API test layer for the pricing service and made it a release gate.

items.headline: Staff Platform Engineer, Kubernetes and cloud reliability
items.summary: Twelve years running the ground other engineers build on. Designs cloud platforms as products: Kubernetes clusters teams deploy to without tickets, infrastructure as code that reviews like software, and observability that tells you what broke before the customer does. Has carried the pager for systems with real money on them.

achievements: Built the internal developer platform on Kubernetes, Helm and Argo CD; sixty services deploy through it several times a day with no platform ticket.
Migrated the core infrastructure to Terraform with reviewed, tested modules; environment drift dropped to zero.
Designed the observability stack on OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana, and the SLOs that page a human only when a customer would notice.
Ran the multi-region GCP footprint for live event peaks, including the runbooks and game days that rehearsed them.
Cut monthly cloud spend by a third through rightsizing, spot capacity and autoscaling tuned to real traffic.
Led the incident process: blameless postmortems, error budgets and the follow-through that closed them.
Automated provisioning and patching for a Linux fleet of several hundred hosts.
Built the first CI pipelines and configuration management the company shipped from.

items.headline: Senior Data Engineer, pipelines and analytics platforms
items.summary: Nine years building the pipelines a company's numbers depend on. Batch and streaming, Spark and Kafka, warehouses on BigQuery and Snowflake modeled with dbt so that finance, product and data science read one truth. Cares about lineage, tests and cost as much as throughput.

achievements: Designed the lakehouse and the dbt models that became the single source for regulatory reporting, product analytics and risk.
Built the streaming ingestion on Kafka that lands transactions in the warehouse within seconds, with schema evolution handled by contract.
Cut warehouse spend by forty percent by reworking partitioning, incremental models and query patterns.
Rebuilt the nightly Spark pipelines into orchestrated, tested Airflow DAGs; failures went from weekly to rare and visible.
Modeled the order and catalog domains for analytics used by two hundred internal users.
Owned the migration from an on-premise warehouse to Snowflake without a reporting outage.

items.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer, design systems and accessibility
items.summary: Ten years on the front end, the last five building the design systems other teams ship with. Components in React and TypeScript documented in Storybook, tokens that keep code and Figma in agreement, and accessibility to WCAG AA treated as a requirement rather than an audit. Works with designers as a peer, not a renderer.

achievements: Built and maintains the component library used by eleven product teams; adoption reached ninety percent of new screens within a year.
Set up the token pipeline from Figma to code so that a color change ships everywhere in one pull request.
Led the accessibility program that took the product to WCAG 2.1 AA and kept it there with automated and manual audits.
Rebuilt the article and homepage rendering on React with server-side rendering; Core Web Vitals moved from failing to green across the site.
Created the shared UI kit across four publications and the visual regression tests that guard it.
Reduced JavaScript shipped per page by half through code splitting and a leaner dependency policy.

items.headline: Senior Backend Engineer, Go and high-throughput services
items.summary: Nine years writing the services that sit on the hot path: Go, gRPC and Postgres, tuned with profiles rather than guesses. Has built matching engines, ingestion APIs and the internal libraries a whole backend organization standardizes on. Prefers boring, observable systems and knows when one goroutine is enough.

achievements: Designed the dispatch matching service in Go that pairs shipments with carriers in real time across the marketplace, with p99 latency under fifty milliseconds.
Built the event ingestion API on gRPC and NATS that receives telemetry from tens of thousands of vehicles.
Wrote the internal Go service framework (config, tracing, health, retries) that every new backend service starts from.
Rewrote the bidding endpoint from a scripting runtime to Go, cutting infrastructure cost by seventy percent at the same traffic.
Built the Kafka consumers that aggregate billions of daily events into reporting stores.
Introduced load testing and profiling as part of the release checklist.
